item.title: Yellow Lounge
item.description: Yellow Lounge Yellow Lounge was born in the Berlin club scene to introduce a new idea of classical music accessible by everyone.

item.title: true/false
item.description: true/false true/false is a kinetic sculpture by onformative, composed of arrays of circular black metal segments set in mechanical columns.

item.title: The New Real
item.description: The New Real The New Real is a partnership between the University of Edinburgh, Alan Turing Institute and Edinburgh’s Festivals that explores how art and creativity can help to radically change how we think about AI design.

item.title: The Infinite Bridge
item.description: The Infinite Bridge The Infinite Bridge is a multi-disciplinary live performance project connecting artists and creative professionals across cultures and practices.

item.title: Web development & Digital culture
item.description: Web development & Digital culture Simplon.co is a digital school that aims for a positive social impact.

item.title: Residuum
item.description: Residuum Residuum is a light art installation created by Paul Marlier and exhibited in August and September 2016 at Espace Ecureuil, Foundation for contemporary art, in Toulouse, France.

item.title: PANORAMA
item.description: PANORAMA PANORAMA was an independent art programme hosted by Genesis Cinema, the home of independent film in East London, to offer a platform for emerging artists to exhibit and discuss their work, develop new networks and get inspired.
